description: Advances: ancora.tasks. Calibrated severity: Medium. Found by the ancora-41r.4 verifier: Index.build returns an error tuple that validate/2 subscripts as a map; every Mix task guards the flag first, so no documented sentence is falsified, but the semver-stable library entry point dies on a direct bad option. Also from 41r.2: spec.status and spec.prime print a subject count from a third code path that agrees today but is unasserted. Filed at ancora-41r delivery (2026-09-04) from grader advisories; every item was measured or read by a cold grader and left out of the release scope on purpose. Not a full implement-tier contract: run /investigate or write the contract before /implement. Review-bar-override: release scope decision by Manuel on 2026-09-04; reason above.

comments.text: Partial resolution merged in [PR #6](https://github.com/iautom8things/ancora/pull/6) as 82c2ca8, version 1.2.1. Ancora.validate/2 now returns an environment error for missing workspaces and failed indexing instead of subscripting an error tuple; a direct public-API regression covers the missing-workspace case. The separate subject-count coverage concern in this ticket was not addressed. Keeping this ticket open; package publication is also pending.

title: Ancora.validate/2 raises FunctionClauseError when a library caller passes a bad spec_dir
